snippet.title: Rottenroots - Episode 1 Launch Trailer  | STEAM
snippet.description:
Rottenroots - Episode 1 Trailer

Download Episode 1 for FREE on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547500/Rottenroots_Episode_1/

Get your first look at Rottenroots, our story-driven visual novel with RPG elements! Episode 1 is now available, with Episodes 2-4 set to launch simultaneously in 2026. Rootenroots is a narrative-heavy game where your choices create meaningful consequences, featuring LGBTQ+ characters and complex moral dilemmas.

SUPPORT THE FULL GAME: If you enjoy what you see, please wishlist the complete Rottenroots experience! Your wishlists directly support our small indie team and help us bring this story to life: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177730/Rottenroots/
